sources.title: Housing and economic needs assessment
sources.role: National planning practice guidance for assessing local housing need and economic development needs.
sources.facts: Updated 24 February 2025. The standard method identifies a minimum annual housing-need figure and is distinct from a housing requirement or land-allocation decision.
sources.origin: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government.
sources.guard: Housing-need formulas, delivery tests, programme guidance and opportunity registers do not by themselves prove an exact parcel is allocated, deliverable, viable, funded, available, affordable, permissioned or capable of meeting a local authority housing requirement.

sources.title: Housing supply and delivery
sources.role: National guidance on five-year housing land supply and the Housing Delivery Test.
sources.facts: Updated 12 December 2024. Five-year supply and the Housing Delivery Test use defined authority-level calculations and do not establish parcel-level deliverability.

sources.role: Current national policy chapter on housing supply, site identification and delivery.
sources.facts: Current policy includes authority-level supply and delivery requirements, including a decision-making buffer taking effect from 1 July 2026 in specified circumstances.

sources.title: Housing Delivery Test measurement rule book
sources.role: Official method for calculating authority-level Housing Delivery Test results.
sources.facts: Updated 12 December 2024. The test compares net homes delivered with homes required over a rolling three-year period.

sources.facts: Published 12 December 2024 and covers financial years 2020/21 to 2022/23; publication notes a delayed timetable for later measurements.

sources.facts: Updated 28 January 2026. Registration and database presence indicate an opportunity workflow, not a completed transaction, secured provider or planning outcome.

sources.facts: Updated 8 February 2021. Register entries evidence demand and duties but do not guarantee a specific plot, land availability, acquisition or planning permission.
